verses.text: By David. I’ll thank you with my whole heart. Right in front of the gods I’ll sing your praise.
I’ll bow toward your holy temple and thank your name for your faithful love and truth, because you’ve lifted your name and your word above everything.
When I called, you answered me that very day. You gave me courage and made me strong inside.
LORD, every king on earth will thank you because they’ve heard the words you spoke.
They’ll sing about the LORD’s ways, because the LORD’s glory is great!
The LORD is high up, yet he looks after those who are low. He knows the proud from far away.
Even if I walk right through trouble, you’ll give me life again. You’ll stretch out your hand against my enemies’ anger, and your right hand will save me.
The LORD will finish what concerns me. LORD, your faithful love lasts forever. Don’t walk away from what your own hands have made.
